summary: Iteration 11 (frontend-only): Verified StandardSidebar integration on 6 editorial pages (/geruechte, /ticker, /top-deals, /abloesefrei, /deadline-day, /suche). All pages render data-testid='standard-sidebar' with visible TrendingWidget on desktop (1920x1080). On mobile (390px) the sidebar is present in DOM but correctly hidden (Tailwind 'hidden lg:block'). Billboard container renders reliably after client-side navigation between all tested routes. Megabanner container was not detected by [class/id/testid*='megabanner'] selectors (may be rendered under a different identifier or intentionally not on these pages). HomePage (/) does NOT render the StandardSidebar component (no data-testid='standard-sidebar'), but TrendingWidget IS visible elsewhere on the home layout.

ui_bugs.issue: StandardSidebar (data-testid='standard-sidebar') is NOT present on '/'. Requirement states 'HomePage (/) hat Sidebar mit Trending Widget'. TrendingWidget itself is visible, but the standardized sidebar (containing SidebarAd 300x600 + MREC ads) is missing. If intentional (home has custom layout), please confirm; otherwise add <StandardSidebar/> to HomePage grid.

issues: Could not locate a Megabanner container via [id/class/data-testid*='megabanner'] selectors on any page after navigation. Billboard container is present. If Megabanner should be verifiable, expose a data-testid='megabanner' attribute for reliable QA.

action_items: Decide/confirm whether HomePage should also include <StandardSidebar/> (currently absent). Trending shows via TrendingWidget but the ad units (300x600, MREC, MREC2) from the shared sidebar are missing on '/'.
Add data-testid='megabanner' (and 'billboard') on TheMoneytizerAds mount points to enable robust QA verification of ad reload on route change.
Note: External ads report CORS errors from go.affec.tv preflight and net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED — expected on preview (domain not autorisiert per E1).
critical_code_review_comments: StandardSidebar uses `key={location.pathname}` on each ad component to force remount on route change — good pattern for reliable ad reload.
StandardSidebar.jsx correctly uses `hidden lg:block` so mobile hides sidebar (verified at 390px).
HomePage should either reuse <StandardSidebar/> for consistency or the requirement should be scoped to editorial pages only.

success_rate.frontend: 86% (6/7 pages meet the sidebar requirement; HomePage missing StandardSidebar)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 editorial pages (/geruechte, /ticker, /top-deals, /abloesefrei, /deadline-day, /suche) show data-testid='standard-sidebar' visible on desktop and hidden on mobile — verified via Playwright. Trending widget visible on all. Billboard container mounts and re-mounts across navigations. HomePage (/) does NOT contain StandardSidebar — needs main agent decision. External ad domains blocked in preview environment (expected).
